GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off all clear, runing on took over approaching 100m, drew half clear, kept on strong, headed late # had chance

Away OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field 3 Wide With Cover (5L from lead). Stayed same until improving 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed out Seven Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 9W @ 250m & challeneged leaders @ 150m. Drew clear in last 100m. # Wide/too strong
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 lengths. got up inside turn 2 lengths. weakened. # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1/2kg overweight in accordance with the policy.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 2 lengths. looking for run turn. got split 200 metres. got clear late # too good
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn. ran on well late # start no help
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got up fence turn 2 lengths. ran on well # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 6 lengths. 5th turn 5 lengths. ran on well # Even Effort
Slow Out 2 lengths Settled Down last 4 lengths. looking for run turn 2 lengths. got split in Straight . battled away # start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. For some distance passing the 250m had difficulty establishing a run to the outside of rnr which was shifting out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down 5th 2 lengths. looking for run turn 2 lengths. held up down Straight . got late split to run on strongly # got up last stride
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: It was established that passing 150m after improving into a narrow run rdr was accidently struck on the right arm by the whip of another rdr. When questioned as to why over the concluding stages it was apparent that rdr had his elbow extended out, rdr explained at this time he had a very long right rein which made it awkward for him to ride his mount in a fashion to get it to lower its head in the drive to the line and that he had become unbalanced. Stwds warned rdr of the seriousness of a circumstance where a rdr was found to have intentionally made contact with another rdr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 6 lengths. looking for run turn 4 lengths. held up until 150 metres. ran on strongly when clear # not much luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rounding the home turn was held up and unable to improve. Remained held up for clear running until near the 150m where it was shifted out around heels to improve. When questioned regarding his riding in the straight and why he did not improve into an available run between runners near the 250m rider explained that is a horse that possess a short sprint and also appreciates room to make its finishing run.
